d:
Renowned Educator and founder of Drishti IAS coaching Vikas Divyakirti joins The Lallantop's newsroom. He joins as a guest for the show 'Guest in the Newsroom'. Divyakirti is one of the most popular teachers in the country. He is a popular face among UPSC aspirants. Many topics were discussed with Divyakirti including, UPSC preparations, his personal life, his marks in class 12th, his connection with RSS, his dreams, and how he started Drishti IAS coaching among others. Watch the video to know all about Vikas Divyakirti.
Produced By: The Lallantop
Edited By: Rajat Sain
